info.title: Pastebin API
info.description: A Web API for creating and viewing highlighted code snippets.

get.description:
This viewset automatically provides `list`, `create`, `retrieve`,
`update` and `destroy` actions.

Additionally we also provide an extra `highlight` action.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: A page number within the paginated result set.
